title: $30MN+ US MQ-9 Reaper drone DOWNED by Iranian forces, wreckage already recovered
text:
$30MN+ US MQ-9 Reaper drone DOWNED by Iranian forces, wreckage already recovered"

"Iranian naval forces have published footage and photos showing the destruction and subsequent recovery of the wreckage of a US military MQ-9 drone in the southern port city of Asaluyeh.
